overview.Name: RF Acquisition Corp II
overview.Description: RF Acquisition Corp II does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company intends to focus its search for a business combination on target businesses in the technology sector, including artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and biotechnology in Asia. RF Acquisition Corp II was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Singapore.
